thread:
rachel: BigBank team asks for a short POC tomorrow to stream OCRed pages into their case system. They want structured annotations + function-calls. Can eng confirm viability?

clare: We need to clarify retention (security Q) and whether they require VPC peering. Also procurement asked about hosted vs dedicated pricing delta.

mike: Hosted OK for <5 concurrent streams. For sustained realtime we recommend Dedicated (reserved) 30 roughly 3x-4x cost per token but predictable. I can attach numbers after the call.

eng-bot: Deployed sample webhook receiver to staging: https://staging.redwood.example/poc-bigbank. Logs open to invited users.

tom: SDK note: streaming snippet (ts/js) supports function_call events. We'll send example that emits one function per chunk with {message_id, chunk_index, annotations}. Recommend client chunking ~4k tokens to avoid context issues.

rachel: Can someone drop a one-paragraph summary for the calendar invite? Need bullets + blockers.

clare: Summary: POC goal: stream OCR -> token-level annotations into BigBank case system via function-calls. Blockers: confirm annotation schema & idempotency keys, VPC peering requirement, retention policy answer for security questionnaire, and expected concurrency to size Dedicated. Ask: Eng to join kickoff to validate SDK flow and run live test.

mike: I'll join and bring pricing slide + sample code. tom will demo streaming -> function_call -> webhook.

rachel: Thanks all. I'll update invite and attach sample schema. Ping me for urgent items.
